title: Liberia tightens Ebola screening amid regional outbreak
detail: AllAfrica reports Liberia has tightened Ebola screening measures in response to the regional outbreak. Specific measures and case status were not available in the triage summary.

title: Ebola outbreak reaches widest geographic expansion ever, spanning Nigeria, Congo and Kenya
detail: The New York Times reports the Ebola outbreak in Africa has reached its widest geographic expansion on record, with spread across Nigeria, Congo and Kenya. Case counts and details were not available in the triage summary.

media.caption: Ebola outbreak reaches widest geographic expansion ever
